subject: general
question: In a logic circuit, three SPST (Single Polle Single Throw) switches are used to implement a logic gate. The switches are connected in series. What is the output of the circuit if all switches are closed?

options.text: The output will depend on the type of gate used

solution:
The correct answer is __1**(1)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• SPST (Single Pole Single Throw)__ switches are basic components used in logic circuits to control the flow of current.
 
• When all switches are connected in series and closed, the circuit allows current to flow freely.
 
• This setup emulates the behavior of an AND gate.
 
• For an AND gate, the output is 1 only when all inputs are 1.
 
• Therefore, if all the switches are closed, the output will be 1.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **AND Gate:**

 
 
• The AND gate outputs 1 only when all its inputs are 1.
 
• It is commonly implemented using switches in series.
 
 
 
• **OR Gate:**
 
 
• Outputs 1 if any of its inputs are 1.
 
• Implemented using switches in parallel.
 
 
 
• **NOT Gate:**
 
 
• Inverts the input signal.
 
• Outputs 1 for input 0, and vice versa.
